March 28: Trump again extended the deadline by 10 days, claiming Iran asked (they didn't). He said he'd obliterate their civilization if there was no deal (there wasn't).

April 6: Trump extended the deadline by 2 weeks, threatening destruction if the Strait wasn't opened during that period (it wasn't).
